sources.full: Iron Kingdoms: Minds of Metal, Hearts of Fire

itemProperty.name: Alchemical Weapon
entries: Whenever you fire an alchemical weapon, you can load a mundane or magical alchemical item (such as a grenade or alchemical fire) instead of normal ammunition. If you load an alchemical item, the weapon deals no damage of its own type; instead, the alchemical item's effects apply to the target.

itemProperty.name: Storm
entries: On a hit, the target takes an additional {@damage 1d8} lightning damage from the weapon's electrical field.

itemProperty.name: Storm Generator
entries: While this weapon is active, the steamjack can use its action to make a ranged attack (range 30/120 ft.) that deals {@damage 2d8} lightning damage on a hit, without using the weapon's melee attack.

item.name: Condemner
entries: Firearm (range 60/180). Loading. Magazine (8).

A creature hit by a Condemner catches fire. At the start of each of its turns, the burning creature takes {@damage 1d4} fire damage. The creature can end this damage by using its action to extinguish the flames.

item.name: Skyhammer
entries: AOE. Firearm (range 100/300). Magazine (20).

Each Skyhammer rocket has a 5-foot radius area of effect. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + the steamjack's Dexterity modifier + its proficiency bonus). On a failed save, the creature takes the weapon's damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

item.name: Flame Fists
entries: On a critical hit, the target takes an additional {@damage 2d6} fire damage.

item.name: Shoulder Cannon
entries: Firearm (range 30/90). Loading. Magazine (8).

A creature hit by a Shoulder Cannon must make a Strength saving throw with a DC equal to 15 or the damage dealt, whichever is higher. On a failed save, the target is pushed 10 feet directly away from the steamjack.

item.name: Dozer
entries: Firearm (range 40/120). Magazine (6).

A heavy slug cannon with a six-shot revolver. A creature hit by a Dozer must make a Strength saving throw with a DC equal to 15 or the damage dealt, whichever is higher. On a failed save, the target is pushed 10 feet directly away from the steamjack.
Unlike most steamjack weapons, a Dozer can be reloaded during combat. Each cylinder takes 1 minute to reload. A Dozer cannot be loaded with other ammunition.

item.name: Shield Fist
entries: A large shield bolted to a steamjack's forearm. While equipped, the steamjack gains +2 AC. The steamjack can perform shoves without attacking while equipped with a Shield Fist and does not need a free hand to do so. Shield Fists count as a shield.

item.name: Shoulder Launcher
entries: Alchemical Weapon. Firearm (range 30/90). Magazine (3).

A series of attached launchers designed to fire grenades. Load any grenade or alchemical item as ammunition; the weapon deals damage equal to that item's damage instead of its own. The launcher holds up to 3 grenades at once.

item.name: Toro Heavy Warjack Chassis
entries: Chassis only (without cortex). Full price with Aurum-grade cortex: 11,500 gp.
Fuel Load/Burn Time: 660 lb. coal / 5 hours general, 1 hour combat.
Stock Cortex: Aurum-grade.

Originally designed by Castellan Ironworks in Merin, the Toro is a solid and dependable heavy warjack popular with mercenary companies for its affordability and adaptability. The Toro comes stock with a Battle Blade and a Shield. See the Toro creature entry.

item.name: Devastator Heavy Warjack Chassis
entries: Chassis only (without cortex). Full price with Aurum-grade cortex: 14,000 gp.
Fuel Load/Burn Time: 1,125 lb. coal / 4 hours general, 45 minutes combat.
Stock Cortex: Aurum-grade.

A Khador heavy warjack loaded with heavy ordinance from Cygnaran forces, the Devastator boasts interlocking shield systems that allow it to close itself against incoming fire. The Devastator comes stock with a Multi-Chamber Compression Cannon and a Battle Mace. See the Devastator creature entry.

item.name: Storm Accumulator
entries: Powerful Cygnaran technology designed for warjacks working alongside Storm Knights, this device allows a steamjack to harvest galvanic energy produced by Cygnar's lightning weapons. It also acts as a universal lightning rod, protecting the steamjack from electrical attacks by simply grounding them without affecting the steamjack.
A steamjack equipped with a Storm Accumulator has {@b immunity to lightning damage}.
At the start of each of its turns, if the steamjack is within 10 feet of a friendly creature wielding a weapon with the Storm property or a Lightning Rod, it gains 1 focus point, up to its maximum.
Installing a Storm Accumulator requires an additional 50 gp in labor.

item.name: Shoulder Mounts
entries: An ingenious system first developed for the Devastator chassis, this upgrade allows a steamjack to mount ranged weapons across its shoulders, leaving its arms free. These shoulder mounts have a major downside: the recoil can unbalance the steamjack and knock it down.

A steamjack with this upgrade can mount up to two ranged weapons on its shoulders. However, any time one of these weapons is fired, after the attack is resolved, the steamjack must make a {@b DC 12 Strength saving throw} or be knocked {@condition prone}.
Installing Shoulder Mounts requires an additional 100 gp in labor.

item.name: Shield System
entries: The shield system allows a steamjack to benefit from two shields at once. A steamjack equipped with this upgrade can equip and benefit from two shields simultaneously, adding both shields' AC bonuses.
Installing a Shield System requires an additional 80 gp in labor.

item.name: Storm Blaster
entries: Firearm (range 50/150). Loading. Mechanika (Storm Chamber, 2 charges per shot).
If this attack hits, the nearest two enemy creatures within 10 feet of the target also suffer {@damage 1d8} lightning damage.

item.name: Generator Blade
entries: Reach. Storm. Storm Generator (30/120). Mechanika (Storm Chamber, 5 charges per minute).
Storm: On a hit, the target takes an additional {@damage 1d8} lightning damage.
Storm Generator: The steamjack can use its action to make a ranged attack (range 30/120 ft.) that deals {@damage 2d8} lightning damage on a hit. This attack does not use the blade's melee attack.
A Generator Blade's Storm Chamber holds 28 charges.

monster.name: Toro
languages: understands the languages of its manufacturer but can't speak

trait.name: Belligerent
entries: If the Toro moves up to 20 feet in a straight line and then makes a melee attack, that attack deals an additional {@damage 2d6} damage on a hit.

trait.name: Cortex
entries: The Toro's cortex allows it to understand basic commands from its controller (spoken verbally by most but usually communicated telepathically by warcasters). Verbal commands must be akin to those issued to a trained animal, such as "stay," "guard," or "attack." The Toro carries out these commands with no regard for its own safety.

trait.name: Heavy Metal
entries: The Toro's attacks are magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks for steamjackets, colossi, and warjacks.

trait.name: Steam Powered
entries: The Toro requires coal and water to function. When not in combat, it can function for 5 hours with a full fuel load of 660 pounds of coal and fresh water. When in combat, it can function for 1 hour with a full fuel load. If its fuel is not refilled at the end of this time, it suffers one level of exhaustion at the end of each minute. Due to the heat its steam engine produces, the Toro has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Toro makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Melee Weapon Attack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d8+6}) bludgeoning damage.

languages: understands the languages of its manufacturer but can't speak

Due to the heat its steam engine produces, the Devastator has disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

trait.name: Sturdy
entries: Due to its low center of gravity and massive weight, a Devastator cannot be knocked prone by nonmagical means and cannot be pushed by a creature of Large size or smaller.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Devastator makes two melee attacks.
